name: Oklahoma Championship 2026
information: ## [Southern Cubing](southerncubing.com) welcomes you to the the Third Annual Oklahoma State Championship! While only residents of Oklahoma are eligible for the title of Oklahoma State Champion, all competitors are welcome and encouraged to compete! More information can be found on the [Oklahoma Champion Titles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OklahomaChampionship2026#68918-oklahoma-champion-titles) tab. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTA5ODQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d90b474725899b23c9c5d15d90dc03063159a03c/southernCubing.png)
